items.title: Albert Jiles Interview, 1961-02-24
items.q: He had the John. Sam Lee on tenor.

ctx.x: I was trying to think of them. You must have had more than one. That's what I'm trying to think of. He had three. He had the. He had the. He had the John. Sam Lee on tenor. You know what I mean?
Yeah. I don't know about that.
